row.title: Q-CLOCK-LANE-HOOK: the lane heals the clocks after every pass
row.body: lane.yml runs python3 -m foundation clock --heal --apply as its last step (4 minute cap, Cloudflare token as in product-manager.yml), so a stale stage is caught within one merge cycle and not a day later. test_pm checks the step, its token and its cap.
